## anu-p03 — argument map

Worship, worshipper, worshipped — what difference-course in the unsurpassed? Transition: of whom, by whom effected, who enters? In the oneness of anuttara, what talk, what differentiated path? Māyā, not different from consciousness-nonduality, in otherness, though different — alas, stands. All is pure own-experience-nature; vain thought, do not.

### Open
- Whether 'māyeyam' is 'this Māyā' or 'Māyā, this [illusion]' is unresolved.
- Whether 'bhinnā api' (though different) modifies Māyā or the illusion is unresolved.
